resources.string: Offline Chinese / English input method. Built-in Pinyin engine (full Pinyin and T9), fuzzy Pinyin, abbreviated Pinyin, mixed Chinese/English input, English completion and correction, offline self-learning, and optional Wanxiang model enhancement. All input stays offline.

Optional enhancement model and full dictionary downloads are available below. They are not required: the built-in seed dictionary and base grammar can already type offline. Download them later if you want broader or more accurate candidates.
Unable to check for updates (network unavailable)
Storage: %1$s (app-private directory, hidden from file managers; local only and removable).
Optional ~401 MB download. Chinese candidates become noticeably more accurate after download (internal evaluation top-1 + about 9 points). Stored locally only; input remains fully offline.
✅ Enabled: enhanced grammar is active (downloaded %1$d MB, local only; loaded after switching to Aegis)
⚠ Enhanced grammar is not enabled - download the ~401 MB model to enable it
Up to date, no update (enhancement model is already current)
⚠ Enhanced grammar is not enabled (deleted; restart the input method to release any loaded model)

Optional full dictionary download, about 243 MB extracted (characters, base words, associations, sound corrections, polyphones, poetry, places, medicine, chemistry, drugs, notable names, variants, species, and personal names). The built-in high-frequency seed dictionary works offline without download; the full pack broadens Chinese candidate coverage. Stored locally only; input remains fully offline.
✅ Downloaded and enabled: full dictionary (about %1$d MB, local only; switch/restart Aegis to load broader Chinese coverage)
⚠ Full dictionary is not downloaded - optional ~98 MB compressed pack (~243 MB extracted; built-in seed dictionary already works offline)
Verification or extraction failed (file may be corrupt, please retry)
Up to date, no update (full dictionary is already current)
⚠ Full dictionary deleted (built-in seed dictionary remains available)
Tolerate common Pinyin confusions; each rule can also be toggled separately. Takes effect next time you switch to Aegis.
Show next-word predictions in the candidate bar while typing. Off by default; you can enable it.
Default keyboard for Chinese input (English always uses 26 keys).

Aegis learns your frequent words and next-word pairs offline and stores them as the learning dictionary on this device. This is separate from the downloaded main dictionary: import/overwrite here only changes the learning dictionary and never changes the main dictionary. Imports take effect next time you switch to Aegis.
Default dictionary: %1$s (app-private directory, hidden from file managers; use Export to copy it out. Default file name: aegis-userdb.txt).
Import failed: file cannot be read or has no valid entries; dictionary was not changed

This imports/exports the learning dictionary (userdb.txt - words and frequencies learned on this device), not the downloaded main dictionary. Merge adds imported entries to the current learning dictionary with dedupe and accumulated frequencies. Overwrite replaces the learning dictionary with the imported file. Neither option changes the downloaded main dictionary.
Aegis app release label. This is separate from the learning dictionary, main dictionary, and model files.
Import failed: file cannot be read; phrases were not changed
Import failed: no valid content; phrases were not changed
